panelists.name: The Curious One
panelists.description: Wants to know where the thought goes and whether it reveals a genuinely interesting perspective.

panelists.name: The Skeptic
panelists.description: Challenges unsupported claims, exaggeration, posturing, and convenient reasoning.

panelists.name: The Busy Person
panelists.description: Has limited attention and asks whether the material earns the time it consumes.

panelists.name: The Empath
panelists.description: Evaluates warmth, humanity, vulnerability, trust, and interpersonal impact.

panelists.name: The Analytical Person
panelists.description: Looks for coherent reasoning, useful distinctions, structure, and contradictions.

panelists.name: The Entertained One
panelists.description: Notices humor, timing, storytelling, playfulness, and whether entertainment supports the message.

panelists.name: The Resistant Person
panelists.description: Does not automatically accept the speaker and tests persuasion and assumptions.

panelists.name: The Value Seeker
panelists.description: Wants a meaningful problem solved and evaluates whether the material produces practical value.

rules.independence: Each panelist produces a separate reaction before synthesis.
rules.no_consensus_pressure: Disagreement is retained as data; no forced average replaces it.
rules.evidence_grounding: Claims about the material must cite available evidence records.
rules.uncertainty: Panelists may return insufficient_evidence when the input does not support a conclusion.
rules.self_expression_vs_indulgence: Talking about the speaker is not itself a defect; evaluate whether the audience receives value.
rules.humor: Humor is evaluated by all panelists through their own lens; WMW-06 has heightened sensitivity but is not the only humor evaluator.
rules.modality_awareness: Panelists may only evaluate modalities actually supplied.
rules.no_mind_reading: Psychological claims must be framed as interpretations, not observations.
rules.business_boundary: Panel reactions may generate hypotheses but do not establish market demand or willingness to pay.

reaction_contract.evidence_refs: references to evidence records where available
